notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of Outbreak: Shades of Horror can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

Cypress Reel


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

Story mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

Invasion mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

Raid mode


This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of Outbreak: Shades of Horror, Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

Mini-games


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when Outbreak: Shades of Horror begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

Patch 3
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

Patch 2
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

Outbreak: Endless Nightmares twists the series' survival horror gameplay by adding elements of roguelike gameplay. You'll need to explore, hunt for supplies, uncover clues, and fight your way through each anomaly – each consisting of semi-procedurally generated instances where both the environment, and the undead, are out to kill you!

Immediately after the events of Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, you find yourself trapped within the remains of Arzt Memorial Hospital – the hub to organize your inventory and storage cache, level up your character, or just to take a breather before venturing back out into the chaos. There’s more to discover in the world besides murderous hordes of the undead – find the journals scattered about to learn more about the outbreak and ultimately where to find refuge! Don’t think death can save you – every time you die, you'll awake trapped in this nexus.

Each time you venture into the anomaly, it’ll change and become increasingly difficult as you grow in power. notes.title: Outbreak: The New Nightmare v7.0 Released! Local Co-op Added! (Experimental)
notes.content:
The Nightmare never ends. Nearly three years after Outbreak: The New Nightmare released on Steam Early Access, major new features are still being added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28927398/dd94161ed5311f441904eb5c8db644f6781b4c2d.jpg
Outbreak: The New Nightmare 7.0 has been released. It includes the following enhancements:

 Local 2-player co-op is now available. Access it via the Local Game menu (replacing the Single-player menu). You can customize the controls for both players in the Options -> Controls menu. Successfully updating the engine will allow me to keep pushing forward on new features and fixes, as well as update the console versions and target new consoles in the future!

notes.title: Local co-op is coming...
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

Well, it's been a while. But there has been a lot underway behind on the scenes on the Outbreak series since the launch of Outbreak: Epidemic on Xbox One and Steam!

One of the most demanded features across all of the co-op titles in the series is local co-op. I'm happy to announce it's in active development and nearing completion on PC (and then will be coming to consoles in some form in the future) for Outbreak: The New Nightmare. I'll be looking into other titles in the series in the future to see what can happen there, but that will be a discussion for another time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28927398/6de4c1132a448794a5ab42208588b5b96c7996c6.jpg
Although Outbreak: The New Nightmare was a co-op title from day one, online multiplayer and local co-op are two very different beasts. I've found a way to balance the requirements and add proper support, as well as upgrade the underlying engine to the latest version. This local co-op is only possible due to the massive performance upgrades I was able to achieve in the last round of major patching. That being said, you will need a beefy rig to run local co-op on fully maxed out settings and high resolution.

So let's talk about it!

Local Co-op Overview

Local co-op in Outbreak: The New Nightmare covers all game modes, characters and functionality. The main player and your partner are equal in terms of abilities and the opportunity to level up. You'll be using characters from the master Steam account of the owner of the title, but each character will continue to level up independently and you can apply perks just as you can online or in single-player.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28927398/a78f5a35dd7bd77553313ab56ee7792afae15225.jpg
Local co-op is accessible via the "Local Game" menu (replacing the Single-player menu). This menu still allows you to launch offline single-player games, but now there is a toggle to enable co-op and pick the character of your local co-op player. You can also fully customize your keyboard, mouse and gameplay controls for both players in the options menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28927398/dd94161ed5311f441904eb5c8db644f6781b4c2d.jpg
When you're in-game in local co-op, you'll get an EXP bar for each player and you can track leveling up through that. You can also see both people's inventories at the same time through the lobby screen - although for now only one player can use their inventory at a time. In future updates, I hope to continue to improve this, but the UI code for The New Nightmare is old and wasn't written with extensibility like this in mind.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28927398/4501a44321ed8ba72b447196b0100777619c744a.jpg
I'm really excited for this feature to be on the way. I've definitely heard the community feedback and I'm very excited to get it into both PC and console versions as soon as it's possible.

Stay tuned for updates! It's coming soon!

As always, good luck surviving!

    Improved enemy attack hit detection to provide more opportunity for the player to dodge.

notes.title: Welcome to Outbreak! Top tips for new survivors!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f5d3fcf7c17e2326b490eca817dbdb43f52a9ab6.jpg
Welcome to all of the new players of Outbreak: The New Nightmare! Here's some handy tips to start you off in your adventures!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0273c42e04ee4df333cb9a3fd0bdc4c47e010981.jpg
Frame Rate & Performance - DON'T PICK INSANE QUALITY!
In the Options menu, there is a quality option called Insane. When it is selected, the game maxes out the number of shadows, shadow quality, shadow draw distance, AA, AF and much more. It will bring high-end machines to their knees. It's there to assist with getting awesome screenshots, but it's not meant for playing.

Try 'High' or 'Very High' instead as your quality option. They will still look great, have dynamic shadows, high AA and AF, but they will run considerably better!. So don't pick Insane! If you have a low-end machine, select 'Very Low' or 'Low'. On those quality settings, the game will aggressive LOD models to help improve your framerate.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2d7544c31c031ee562717c09e8fc34edf01d3717.jpg
Playing with Friends - I can't see their game!
Outbreak: The New Nightmare uses a region-based cloud networking set-up for multiplayer. It is NOT P2P and almost guarantees that you will NOT have connection issues connecting to friends. It's a good thing. BUT! YOU MUST BE ON THE SAME REGION AS YOUR FRIENDS TO SEE THEIR GAMES! In the Options menu, you can change your region. Move it off Best Ping and have everyone select a region that is closest to the group.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b577cd5eafc5f789586762af3fb6c014507573e6.jpg
Moving Your Character - Camera angle changes mess me up!
If you're having trouble controlling your character using the Modern control scheme, change to the Classic Tank control scheme. This is designed to mimic classic survival horror tank controls and you will not become disoriented when camera changes happen. It's a little less responsive than modern, but you'll thank yourself in the end for using it. Give it a shot!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0a901b654048b8443cdfc661f11e2af9966151be.jpg
Game Difficulty - It's way too hard!!!
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is meant to be a difficult experience. You are weak, have virtually no supplies and enemies are everywhere. But, you can stack the odds in your favor a bit!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9fd67acd9ac44595d31a3deb36f0779fad90effd.jpg
When selecting your character, pick Lydia, Hank or Harry. Lydia and Hank start with powerful weapons. Harry starts with a larger than normal inventory. In addition, make sure you play on Normal difficulty. On Normal, you receive a significant health and healing bonus. When you're in single-player, the boost very substantial. As more players join the game, the boost diminishes.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/eba5497b4da6fbe3878e5c37c184c65ae3ab7fcd.jpg
Also, as you play you will gain XP and level up your character. Each character has unique stats and abilities. Passive stats just become better when leveling up, but you'll want to manually equip your abilities as you unlock them. Play to your strengths!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/4a5d2aa32a98075c9a0c7f2ef42dbc0ee8b1a18a.jpg
Darkness - I can't see anything!
You can toggle a persistent flashlight using the 'F' key or clicking in the right thumbstick on your gamepad when not aiming. This flashlight is available in all scenarios and can greatly help you if the game is too dark!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/e1a15fc77ffe118546519f0fa571917c20e804a0.jpg
Good Luck!
The nightmare is brutral, unforgiving and frustrating. Arm yourself well, use your resources effectively, don't waste time and keep fighting. Oh, and USE YOUR MAP! Good luck!

Thanks to Standemonium!! and Mr RSpeedy for some of the screenshots used in this post!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0a901b654048b8443cdfc661f11e2af9966151be.jpg
Game Difficulty - It's way too hard!!!
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is meant to be a difficult experience. You are weak, have virtually no supplies and enemies are everywhere. But, you can stack the odds in your favor a bit!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9fd67acd9ac44595d31a3deb36f0779fad90effd.jpg
When selecting your character, pick Lydia, Hank or Harry. Lydia and Hank start with powerful weapons. Harry starts with a larger than normal inventory. In addition, make sure you play on Normal difficulty. On Normal, you receive a significant health and healing bonus. When you're in single-player, the boost very substantial. As more players join the game, the boost diminishes.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/eba5497b4da6fbe3878e5c37c184c65ae3ab7fcd.jpg
Also, as you play you will gain XP and level up your character. Each character has unique stats and abilities. Passive stats just become better when leveling up, but you'll want to manually equip your abilities as you unlock them. Play to your strengths!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/4a5d2aa32a98075c9a0c7f2ef42dbc0ee8b1a18a.jpg
Darkness - I can't see anything!
You can toggle a persistent flashlight using the 'F' key or clicking in the right thumbstick on your gamepad when not aiming. This flashlight is available in all scenarios and can greatly help you if the game is too dark!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/e1a15fc77ffe118546519f0fa571917c20e804a0.jpg
Good Luck!
The nightmare is brutral, unforgiving and frustrating. Arm yourself well, use your resources effectively, don't waste time and keep fighting. Oh, and USE YOUR MAP! Good luck!

Thanks to Standemonium!! and Mr RSpeedy for some of the screenshots used in this post!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 1/4/2018
notes.content:

Hey Survivors! We made it!

Leaving Steam Early Access on Jan 5th at 1PM EST!
After just about 7 months in Early Access, it's now time to move on. The game has been content complete for about two months now and the focus since then has been polishing through smaller, less drastic patches. As of right now, the game is fairly stable, runs much better than when we launched Early Access and represents the experience I was aiming for! I'm very happy to transition out of Early Access and allow a larger group of players to start trying to survive the nightmare!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1ed1b97a8087e8dbfd383c616936a13b316461a6.jpg
THANK YOU to everyone for your support, feedback and constructive criticism during Early Access. I directly implemented tons of community feedback and I encourage you to go back and look at all of our patch notes to see that evolution over time!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/487a2fcbbb7efb92200ff3a23a26091a55a3ab83.jpg
But... the game isn't perfect! Why would you leave Early Access!?
Well, the fact is the game will never be perfect. I'm a solo indie developer (with some awesome community support from Standemonium!! and Mr RSpeedy!) and there are hard limits to my resources and time. I've built Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare over 2+ years working hours daily. I fronted the budget for these games. And I'm very proud of what was produced here. :)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b5b1eb1bb4ba7986224c45f48173c278ac13ab28.jpg
But it's important to aim for milestones and recognize when you hit them. 'The enemy of good is perfection' and I honestly feel Outbreak: The New Nightmare is good. Maybe the animations aren't perfect (I've spent two months trying to upgrade them, but the breakages were too significant), maybe performance isn't perfect (but it has come SO FAR in Early Access), but what's important is the game has been getting fantastic community reception and people are having fun! The content is here. The 4-player co-op is here. Go survive the nightmare and have some fun!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9f440e822585a8b638e819e7266e905c7814eb52.jpg
And this isn't the end. Games never stop being developed. There will be patches. There will be new titles in the Outbreak series. This isn't goodbye, it's just the beginning.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b9b0be857450358ea74c6f2d81d3080010cb2074.png
So I ask you to look past some of the rough edges and focus on having fun!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/15f72274ab66abebdf93346fc0cee9e601c57957.jpg
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is now available on Xbox One!
In addition, you can now find Outbreak: The New Nightmare on Xbox One. It's a special single-player only release on that console, but it has all of the same content and is still a great adventure. Co-op may come sometime down the road, but I just wasn't able to wing it with my resources. But the game is a lot of fun and runs best on Xbox One X! I encourage you to give it a look!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2bfec8f1c61934c81cda6b5aad0702a80a28ba6f.jpg
THANK YOU!
I really mean it. Thank you for all of your feedback, kind words, criticism, streaming, playing and everything else you've done to share the game. I'm very happy that we have an awesome and fun community here! Come talk to us on Discord and grab some co-op buddies! It's time to have some fun, so get out there and start surviving to Wave 25 of Onslaught mode!

A Brief Development History
I started work developing Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare over 2 years ago. These games were created in Unity, written in C# and have been the result of multiple hours of work daily over that time primarily by me. I had some great community support and help along the way from folks like Standemonium!!, Mr RSpeedy and a few other awesome folks as well, which kept me going during those long days. These games were produced with virtually no budget (I paid out of pocket for the dev costs) and were created because I wanted to play games in this genre, even though large developers didn't seem to make them anymore.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/3bdcc72e9c48d58924e78dd5a5ac1e9eeb71db4c.jpg

As we near the full release of the second game in this franchise, I very much hope you are enjoying them too. Don't be shy about filing a positive Steam or Xbox review if you enjoyed the experience as well!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/43ad266498712ff7f87fc266617d6d6b5ca873f3.jpg

The game is currently content complete, so what you buy and play today on discount is the same experience folks will be playing next week. SO GRAB IT NOW WHILE IT'S CHEAP!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 12/10/2017
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/RvxKGFv.gif
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is leaving Steam Early Access in early January 2018. When it transitions to full release, the price will be increasing. Grab it while it's cheap and save some $$$! The game will also be releasing as a single-player title on Xbox One on January 3rd. Preorders will be starting about 2 weeks prior to the launch date.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f393729c30aecbe46788fc9e1a455fcd4898449.png
Heck of a ride
Outbreak: The New Nightmare has now been in Early Access for nearly six months. In that time, I've added huge amounts of content, features, fixes and polish. Much of this work and the shape of the game has been driven by YOU! Community feedback has been frequent and very constructive. A lot of the features present today are because the community requested them. I'm very thankful that everyone has shown the game such support!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1a991798471712a20e092d5b0094407af1d83234.jpg
Now that the game is content complete, we're preparing to transition to a full release. Games are never perfect and there will always be areas that could use a bit more polish, or more features necessary, but it's important to know when it's time to cut a release. As a single developer (with virtually no budget), I'm very proud of the game that was produced. I've learned a lot during the development of this title and I'm very excited to lend that experience towards future survival horror titles.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b59fd900acb3d0a279c1b698d547bb5832146508.jpg
Thanks to everyone in the community for supporting both Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak. Thanks very much for the contributions of Standemonium towards the scenario design for the office and city locations. Thanks to Mr RSpeedy for his massive community contributions (and the great gif above). And a massive thank you to everyone who played the game and took the time to provide Steam reviews as well!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b9b0be857450358ea74c6f2d81d3080010cb2074.png
Console port?
With the imminent transition out of Early Access, it seems like an excellent time to announce the upcoming release of the Xbox One version of the game. Outbreak: The New Nightmare launches on Xbox One on January 3rd, 2018! Preorders will start about two weeks before the release date. As with the XB1 version of Outbreak, this will launch as a single-player affair at a lower price point. But it'll still be great fun!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/741ecc5f2a6bb3c087d8bf3fa35f29a110698d62.jpg
So what other development is happening right now?
I'm currently spending my dev time looking into upgrading the underlying engine to see if we can get any additional performance or graphics polish gains. The upgrade is fairly rough now with the size of the project so no promises, but it would be useful to be able to be on the latest version of Unity.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7ffeb135ff8fbd623ac7f140ebbed01a85b51c23.jpg
Thank you!
Thank you again for making the development of Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak successful and positive experiences! We have an awesome community and I'm very excited for the larger Steam community to be able to play and enjoy the game! Thank you!

notes.title: Outbreak: The New Nightmare is leaving Early Access in Jan. 2018 + Price Increase
notes.content:
https://imgur.com/Vxyagm8.gif
Hi All!

TL;DR
Outbreak: The New Nightmare will leave Steam Early Access in Jan. 2018. When it leaves Early Access, the price will increase. Buy it before then if you want in at the lower price point and it's on sale right now for Halloween at 40% off!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f55de3126ad6a09de7f9d37913666802358e5f72.png
Outbreak has come so far...
I started working on the Outbreak series over two years ago and it has been an awesome experience building new survival horror games. I set out as a single developer with virtually no budget and the majority of these games were assembled by me working very long hours for years.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/97469e9b4562cc906abfb0aec6798a45f509d5e0.jpg
But I also had some amazing help from key people like Standemonium!! who was responsible for designing the layout to the Office and City locations with me, and from folks like Mr RSpeedy who has been an awesome community leader, tester and creator of content. And of course these games could not have been made possible without the fantastic creators on the Unity Asset Store, which I purchased many asset packs to put the overall experience together. Despite the long hours that I put in daily for years to get everything assembled and working, it has been an awesome experience and I'm so excited for what has been built.

My dream when starting the original Outbreak (2D) was to eventually build a 3D HD survival horror game that pays homage to the classics I loved so much. I'm very excited to be here in October 2017 and see that Outbreak: The New Nightmare has fulfilled that dream I had.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/206b49a1d062fbdbcda79900dcc5fb99d1fbbd2f.jpg
Leaving Early Access in Jan. 2018 + Price Increase
With the remaining primary game content coming into place rapidly, it's now time to set a deadline for leaving Early Access. Outbreak: The New Nightmare will leave Steam Early Access in January 2018. When it moves to a full release, the price will increase. I wanted to announce this far in advance so folks who are interested can buy it at the lower price point. It's even on sale right now for 40% off! It was very important for me to offer the game at a discount during Early Access to help support the growth the community. It has been the same price from the day it launched with just three paltry scenarios to today where it sports so many more! I genuinely appreciate everyone who joined and played the game while it was under heavy development since then.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/df8b741b8a6cc6b18cd98b79a7daa82190f8c52d.jpg
Awesome Additions During Early Access
Early Access has been an invaluable tool for me to gather community feedback. The community has been integral in requesting new features, reporting bugs and helping me to guide the overall mechanics getting implemented.

Here's just a short sample of what was added during Early Access (there's no way to list it all):

    Massive performance improvements across the entire game!
    13 new scenarios and 4 brand new locations!
    2 new playable survivors!
    Two new monster types including a brand new acid spit attack!
    An XP/Leveling system with abilities and unlocks.
    Tank controls!
    The DMR!
    The Nightmare difficulty and significant rebalancing of all other difficulties.
    Improvements to the map including scrolling and zooming!
    Massive amounts of smaller features and fixes to improve the overall QoL of the game.
    Tons of feedback submitted directly by the community that has been integrated into the game.
    And much, much more...

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/cf5209f3dc28fc3b9cb55b5734dcb37b7176f067.jpg
Thank You!
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is a game I always wanted to play but no one seemed to want to make. The response from the community has been fantastic and I'm genuinely excited for the future of the game. Once we leave Early Access, you can continue to expect patches and features (but maybe not at the breakneck speed we've seen in Early Access). Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare will continue to be supported for many years to come.

Thank you again to everyone who has been supporting the game. We'll keep working to polish as much as we can in the lead up to leaving Early Access. Keep posting feedback and comments on the message boards. if you enjoy the game and feel it deserves it, a positive Steam review is massively appreciated.

Thank you! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 10/22/2017
notes.content:
https://imgur.com/SGISgYn.gif
Hey survivors! Welcome to another Dev Weekly Update featuring a great gif from Mr RSpeedy!

So... Whatcha been working on all week?
The last week has been a hard push to get the Xbox One version of the game into a shippable state. This has included adding numerous fixes and small enhancements, hooking up remaining services, polishing art & marketing stuff and doing paperwork! There was also a snazzy new XB1 specific trailer created during this time.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/97469e9b4562cc906abfb0aec6798a45f509d5e0.jpg
Right but.. we meant on the Steam-side!
Oh right! We've also been preparing a new patch that has a lot of small fixes and changes, including a reduction of difficulty on Normal in single-player mode. This patch will also include some key fixes to ensure enemies don't get stuck in place or fail to chase/react to players. It should be a significant improvement there, but it has to be tested as it touched some low-level functionality. Expect this patch to show up sometime in the next week after we're sure we didn't break the entire game by accident.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7c8a2ff5558c32f64074109d9a6c4e43150f7922.jpg
Anything else on the horizon we should be looking forward to?
Yes! Sometime in the very near future, we'll be announcing a targeted date for leaving Early Access. The game is coming together very well and we're getting close to a state of feature completeness, which means it'll be time for focusing on polish before the full release! Stay tuned as we want to announce the transition date a bit in advance so people have a chance to buy the game at the lower price point. Once we leave Early Access, we're planning to raise the price of the game, so stay tuned for details there.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1ed1b97a8087e8dbfd383c616936a13b316461a6.jpg
THANK YOU!
Thank you to everyone for playing and sharing feedback! Keep it coming! We're listening closely and although we can't promise we'll implement every piece, it is definitely guiding the direction of the game! Also another special thanks to Standemonium!! for his assistance on the City layout! It came together great and everyone can now play it ingame!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 10/8/2017
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/PSZet5z.gif
Welcome to another weekly dev update, survivors! Let's check up on all of the recent happenings with the development for Outbreak: The New Nightmare

Thank you MrRSpeedy for providing the gifs and some screenshots for this update and the many that preceded it!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7298a493f5efdeebd6c34b728f80667a6a4db117.jpg
New Scenario - The Lab
The lab is the final campaign scenario featuring some genre-classic elements in an exciting finale. As the survivors work their way through the asylum and prison levels, they eventually find a research laboratory. Will it offer them safe refuge from the undead threat...? It's unlikely, but you'll need to play to find out!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a0704a9d3ddba100e1c53138ef732ea796664698.jpg
The lab is a high tech haven that unfortunately birthed the outbreak that's consuming the local area. The survivors will need to pull together and find a way to destroy the source of the outbreak once and for all... but can they make it out alive?
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7c8a2ff5558c32f64074109d9a6c4e43150f7922.jpg
Featuring multiple objectives for the campaign scenario, a classic boss fight and much more, you'll be in for a fight for your life. This location will also feature it's own Onslaught variant, as well as a fun Experiments scenario that we'll discuss some time in the future.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1ed1b97a8087e8dbfd383c616936a13b316461a6.jpg
New Scenario - The City

It's important to note that the city layout was created by Standemonium!! (as well as part of the layout to the Office location). Thank you Stan for the awesome work setting the framework for the map and giving me a nice playground to build it out in!

We've been teasing and hinting at the city location from before the game was released in Early Access. We're finally full steam ahead, putting it all together and making all of the game elements shine in the darkness.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/df8b741b8a6cc6b18cd98b79a7daa82190f8c52d.jpg
The city takes place chronologically as the second scenario in the campaign. After the survivors escape the horrors of the shipping building in Outbreak, they'll find themselves walking out onto the city streets.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/bcd554d0f140bb4ac0683dae8929f6151c7104b5.jpg
The city is in terrible shape. Cars are burning, carnage is everywhere and destruction reigns. The survivors will need to work their way through the undead metropolis and secure a vehicle for escape. During the way, they'll need to clear several obstructions to reach their destination.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/206b49a1d062fbdbcda79900dcc5fb99d1fbbd2f.jpg
As with all locations, the city will feature its own Onslaught and Experiments variants. We're not ready to talk about the latter yet as it's currently in deep development, but stay tuned.
https://i.imgur.com/cCcvjbE.gif
So when do we get to play these new locations?
Sit tight, it's going to be a little bit of a wait. We're going to work on polishing up at least two locations (6 scenarios) for the next content drop. We do not have an ETA for when these will release, but it'll likely be a few weeks at best guess. So sit tight and stay tuned for new screenshots and gifs as development continues!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0e78921952aad6a6baa797ff77d3835d251374ec.jpg
Thank you!
Thank you to everyone for supporting and playing the title. The feedback that has been streaming in is invaluable as we continue to build the game experience and content. Keep posting it on the discussion forums and telling your friends about the game. The best is yet to come!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 9/24/2017
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f55de3126ad6a09de7f9d37913666802358e5f72.png
Hey Survivors! It's time again for a weekly dev update!

New Location - The Asylum
We've just recently wrapped up work on creating the new location - The Asylum. In the Cure campaign scenario, you'll venture deep into the asylum as you seek cover from the growing undead threat. What appears to be a potential safe haven quickly turns deadly as you find it overrun with the monsters. With the entranceway destroyed, you'll need to keep pushing deeper into the complex in hope of repairing the elevator... but will it bring safety?
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f6af3f3bac20d786d9b98ef27371564c1e1750b3.jpg
This location also comes packed with it's own Onslaught and Experiments variants. Onslaught is fairly self explanatory at this point, but the experiments scenario gets interesting.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/dfc83c42fc24fffa4a25fd28faefc1be60cbe9c4.jpg
In "Ephemeral", the Experiments scenario, you'll face invisible threats. Your mission? Simple. Reach the Evac Zone alive. No puzzles, just a straightforward battle with foes you can't see. In addition, supplies will be very tight. You'll need to kill enemies to recover new supplies. So efficiently eliminating foes is key to surviving.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/d13a7676ce9953c64104c1fa9ffc0b36ea64c0c0.png
This content will be releasing soon, but we do not have a firm ETA yet. We're currently doing final testing and expect it to likely become available in the next week or so.

So what else has been happening?
With the Asylum build, we're now moving forward on other new locations. The City continues to be in development and it's our most complicated location yet. We're still not ready to share anything just yet, but stay tuned. In addition, we're beginning work on another new location as well. Expect some screenshots in the coming weeks showing off these new areas!
https://imgur.com/pdQyaH0.gif
And that's about it on the development front. We're very excited for folks to play the asylum, so stay tuned for the new patch dropping sometime in the next week! Good luck and keep surviving!

notes.title: Exploring the Massive New Update!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/TxRVTmJ.gif
We're happy to announce the new major release for Outbreak: The New Nightmare! v3.0.0 contains many significant new features, enhancements and fixes! Let's take a look through some of the big pieces.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/487a2fcbbb7efb92200ff3a23a26091a55a3ab83.jpg
New Characters - Hank and Elena
Hank and Elena join our roster of survivors as the latest entries. These new characters offer their own unique and powerful benefits.

Hank
Hank is a trained soldier and guardsman. He offers significant damage resistance that grows as he levels. More importantly, he starts with a partially loaded Shotgun, making any initial forays into scenarios just a bit easier. With these benefits, Hank makes an excellent starter character (alongside Lydia) for folks and his available abilities are focused around damage and resistance buffs.

Elena
Elena is a burglar and former espionage assassin. After she was discharged by the government, she used her skills to rob the rich. Initially unaware of the apocalypse, she was using the chaos for her own gain but soon enough finds herself stuck with the rest of the survivors fighting for their lives. Elena has two major bonuses that make her an appealing character. She starts with a fully loaded normal handgun. She also has full poison immunity from the get-go. As she levels up, you'll see boosts to handgun damage, as well as containing many abilities to start with healing items and different equipment later on. She's a character for moderately experienced players, but starting with the handgun does make her appealing to many folks starting out.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/97469e9b4562cc906abfb0aec6798a45f509d5e0.jpg
New Enemies - The Monstrosity and the Beast
New threats roam in the darkness and help to build out the cast of horrors that the survivors will face.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a8fe1aec0d7e67169c0ff45ee4704571b0a5b450.jpg
The Beast
The beast is a reptilian-type enemy that moves swiftly and strikes in rapid succession. Although they do less damage than other foes, they can quickly overwhelm you if you're not careful. The beast swipes with his claws, but can also spray a dangerous acid attack at you that can hit at range. Beasts cannot be hit with headshot (aiming upward), but are still susceptible to random critical hits. Bring a power weapon and keep them at bay!

The Monstrosity
The Monstrosity is a hulking beast. Bulging with muscle and a huge claw, the beast can do tremendous damage. If you encounter one, you'll want to bring out your greatest firepower and take him out. He moves slow, but can take punishing damage. In this update, you will only encounter him on much later Onslaught waves.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a8f5e4ee57b16e6de1f1ade12a2db84f5dbfc39e.jpg
New Weapon - The DMR
The DMR makes its triumphant return in Outbreak: The New Nightmare. Similar to its counterpart in the original Outbreak, it packs a punch and can pierce foes. The DMR offers excellent ammo efficiency and can walk the line between taking on crowds, while also being effective against power enemies. But be warned. They are rare. You'll only find one in most scenarios, but they can show up in greater numbers later on in Onslaught mode. The DMR takes Assault Rifle Rounds and fires slower than its Assault Rifle counterpart with a greatly reduced magazine size.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b50d2ab125a80eeceedfc00c6b38952e39c24fbb.jpg
New Attack
Some existing enemies have gained a powerful new attack - the acid blast. This attack spits forward a ball of acid that explodes on impact with players or the environment. It moves fairly quickly, but can be easily sidestepped if you're prepared. Poison enemies will always have it at their disposal.
http://i.imgur.com/cKpmlc0.gif
Other Changes
This update brings some new quality of life features as well.
http://imgur.com/qxs1B8M.gif
Unloading Weapons
One of the most requested features is to remove ammo from weapons. You can now easily do it by combining the weapon with an empty slot in your inventory. This will remove all ammo from the weapon and either place it in your inventory, combine it with existing ammo in your inventory, or drop it on the floor if for any reason your inventory cannot accept the amount of ammo. We'll keep looking for ways to intuitively allow you to unload weapons, but for now this should be an excellent start. Enjoy!

Scenario Changes
Many of the scenarios have had minor changes to integrate new enemies, provide some new supplies or make the DMR available. You might see some new scares in previously safe spaces, so keep your guard up! In Onslaught Mode, you'll see new enemies at different wave tiers, as well as some changes to what weapons can appear. Many of these changes start around Wave 7.

Reminder - Outbreak: The New Nightmare on sale through 9/13!
Just a quick reminder, Outbreak: The New Nightmare is on sale for 40% off through 9/13! Grab it today and try out all of the new content!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b5b1eb1bb4ba7986224c45f48173c278ac13ab28.jpg
And More…
This release also includes many minor fixes, enhancements and fixes not covered here. The patch notes don't even reflect everything. If you notice any issues after this update, please report them in the discussion forums.

Thanks again to everyone for their continued support of Outbreak: The New Nightmare. This adventure has been awesome so far and we still have many more great enhancements and features to come. Progress on the City location is coming along slowly, but it's where our focus will now be turning now that these features are out. Keep posting feedback and if you enjoy the game (and feel it deserves it), please consider leaving a positive Steam review. Thanks and we'll see you out there surviving!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/4fd6edf5ddcff48c5cb6e4fb1fd2d01ff5807d92.jpg
Also big thanks for Mr RSpeedy for his help in aggregating content and testing out this release. His addition to the Special Thanks section in the credits is well deserved!

3.0.1 Hotfix
We've pushed a small hotfix to fix an issue discovered in 3.0.0.

    Onslaught mode enemy layouts updated to integrate the new enemies and for balancing.

    Enemies on fire now deal additional damage.
    Added the DMR weapon and populated it throughout the game.
    Weapons can now be unloaded by combining them with an empty inventory slot.
    Addressed flashlight rotation on the standard Handgun.
    Harry now starts with the Fire Axe instead of the Knife.
    Fixed a small graphics issue in the Office location.
    Added a new player hit reaction direction.
    Standard zombie swing attack changed to give players more of an opportunity to dodge.
    Fixed an issue where non-host players couldn't be poisoned.
    Added the acid spit enemy attack to certain enemies.
    Fixed an issue where the death screen reported an incorrect banner in single-player mode.
    Fixed an issue where the inspection text area would pop up but be empty.
    Adjusted monster XP. Most powerful monsters have had their XP rewards reduced.
    Addressed an issue in the Office location where you could hide behind a vending machine.
    Updated the scrolling gameplay tips and game credits.
    Lowered the random enemy spawn rate a bit on Normal and Hard difficulty modes.
    Addressed lighting issues on the Office location scenarios.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - Upcoming Feature Roadmap
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/144yhYcHo1gWnS/giphy.gif
We've had a blistering two months of frequent feature updates, new content and bug fixes. Feedback from the community has been invaluable towards shaping the game and we're very excited for all of the new items on our roadmap. We thought it'd be useful to talk a little bit more about what to expect and when to expect it.

New Location - City
The next location featured will be the city environment, which connects the office environment and the forest environment within the story. After escaping from the building in the Outbreak scenario, you'll find yourself out on the streets. As the city burns, you'll need to find a way to escape the quarantine zone and make your way to safety.

The city scenario will introduce some new mechanics within the campaign scenario, namely a bit more of a cinematic experience as you try to advance. You'll also be facing new threats as new enemies will appear with new attacks. The city location will feature an Onslaught scenario, as well as its own Experiments scenario, which we're not ready to talk about yet.

New Enemies
The next major update will feature two new enemies. One of which will be a powerful boss-type enemy, and the other one will be a new regular threat. These enemies will come with some new animations and attacks, and some of the existing enemies may see some of these benefits as well.

Onslaught Mode will be enhanced to include these new enemy types. You can expect some tweaking in terms of what types of enemies appear, some stat tweaking and maybe some weapon tweaking.

A New Weapon
We're going to also try to make time to add a new weapon to the game. It will likely be a power-tier weapon (i.e. in the rarity range of the shotgun/assault rifle). The goal with this new weapon will be a tool that can walk the fine line between being useful for standard threats, but also putting up a fight against more powerful foes. As such, you can expect that ammo will be somewhat more scarce than handgun rounds, but less scarce than magnum or grenade launcher rounds.

A New Survivor
We're also planning out the 5th survivor to join the cast. We're not ready to reveal his traits just yet, but he'll fill one of the missing niches to act as a support character. When he is made available, he will have his own XP and skill tree.

The Console Port
We're still working with the folks at Xbox to find the appropriate way and time for Outbreak: The New Nightmare to appear. We have nothing new to report in this area, but we'll likely have news in the next month or two. Stay tuned!

When should we expect this content?
We've been releasing at a rapid pace since the game launched and it's now hitting a point where performance is greatly improved, there's a lot of content and it's very stable. We're going to be focusing on the new content outlined above, which will result in less frequent patches and enhancements. You can expect the above to appear probably within the next 3 months, but we'll keep posting updates on progress.

Why will it take that long to make?
Putting all of this new content together is a huge effort for a one person team, so these things take time. Being able to focus on building, and not frequent patching/releases will give me the room necessary to make these changes.

We'll keep doing frequent updates, but the above is the roadmap you can expect. Stay tuned as we show in progress work while it's built and keep sharing the game with your friends!

Thanks again to everyone for your support. We're very excited to continue the project and release awesome new experiences in Outbreak: The New Nightmare! ːoutbreakzombieː

We're going to also try to make time to add a new weapon to the game. It will likely be a power-tier weapon (i.e. in the rarity range of the shotgun/assault rifle). The goal with this new weapon will be a tool that can walk the fine line between being useful for standard threats, but also putting up a fight against more powerful foes. As such, you can expect that ammo will be somewhat more scarce than handgun rounds, but less scarce than magnum or grenade launcher rounds.

We're also planning out the 5th survivor to join the cast. We're not ready to reveal his traits just yet, but he'll fill one of the missing niches to act as a support character. When he is made available, he will have his own XP and skill tree.

We're still working with the folks at Xbox to find the appropriate way and time for Outbreak: The New Nightmare to appear. We have nothing new to report in this area, but we'll likely have news in the next month or two. Stay tuned!

When should we expect this content?
We've been releasing at a rapid pace since the game launched and it's now hitting a point where performance is greatly improved, there's a lot of content and it's very stable. We're going to be focusing on the new content outlined above, which will result in less frequent patches and enhancements. You can expect the above to appear probably within the next 3 months, but we'll keep posting updates on progress.

Why will it take that long to make?
Putting all of this new content together is a huge effort for a one person team, so these things take time. Being able to focus on building, and not frequent patching/releases will give me the room necessary to make these changes.

We'll keep doing frequent updates, but the above is the roadmap you can expect. Stay tuned as we show in progress work while it's built and keep sharing the game with your friends!

notes.title: Exploring the Latest Update & Weekly Dev Catchup
notes.content:
Hi All!

A little late than we had hoped, but let's take some time to walk through the new additions in the latest major update!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a4eb25e1b9cdebe566f5252599203f076a3b8fc4.jpg
Store Page Refresh
We have a brand new trailer and all new screenshots up on the store page. Check them out to see a lot of this new content in action!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7094960952c43fc64f717f27a46b25a3bf6ddd9a.jpg
Major Performance Improvements
v2.1.0 (released a day after v2.0.0) included a patch to massively improve rendering performance across the game. You should see a substantial boost and we even had a tester running Insane quality on 4K resolution at ~50FPS. So definitely give the game a try and see if your FPS have improved! :)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0787851c93c45eb4439c2ee85fbf3b3ce6600355.jpg
The New Location
We've added a brand new location, The Forest, to the game. You'll leave the claustrophobic confines of the office building and burst into a large, open area. As you explore the hills, you'll find some remnants of the old inhabitants and learn a bit more of the story. With howling wind, intense rain, dense fog and the horrors of the undead, it will make a fun picnic outing.

This location is explored over three different scenarios: a brand new campaign scenario, a new Onslaught scenario and a new Experiments scenario.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/01b74d1b5b07b276c7fc491ae243ec3a859b485b.jpg
Campaign - Faith
This next chapter is told out of order chronologically (as the city location will precede it) but due to development needs it was built first. In Faith, your story picks up as you escaped from the city but your car broke down in the highlands. As you fight through the weather, you'll begin to come across the remnants of other survivors and begin to learn a bit more of the truth as you attempt to repair a vehicle to escape.

Featuring more classic puzzles from the days of survival horror past, you'll need to read logs, search the environment based on clues and find everything you need to survive. With almost no visibility and light, the undead can come up from any direction. Good luck!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/ed64d34f824c0e586b9934c3d3ea814ac6f3f52a.jpg
Onslaught - Forest
The latest Onslaught level presents a slightly new take on the classic formula. With more room to navigate (larger passageways) you'll find you have maneuverability that simply wasn't possible in the office location. But be careful, those wide passageways can work against you as the zombies become literal walls blocking you into corners. With far more ground to cover, you need to keep on your toes, search for supplies and battle the incoming threats.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7ffeb135ff8fbd623ac7f140ebbed01a85b51c23.jpg
Experiments - Countdown
Relive the glory days of a classic survival horror bonus mode as you race against the clock. In Countdown, there is a timer always decreasing and you're dead when it hits zero. Kill enemies and perform melee attacks to gain more time. But if you heal... you'll be penalized. This mode is all about memorization, so make sure to spend a few attempts just learning the map and layout. And if you make it all the way to the end... something horrible is waiting for you.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/15f72274ab66abebdf93346fc0cee9e601c57957.jpg
Nightmare Difficulty
Did you think Biohazard Difficulty was rough? Then great ready for pure torture. Nightmare ups the ante by making enemies incredibly deadly - one hit and you're gone. Any mistake is immediately punished, an imperfect run results in immediate failure. But the apocalypse isn't totally unforgiving - you'll find your own abilities greatly enhanced. Firearms will do a bit more damage... but melee attacks will be absolutely destructive towards enemies. A level 25 Kane is a force to be reckoned with on this mode.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9fc85f69e420231bd4e861843699a1c07586e819.jpg
Other Additions
In addition to these major features, there's a ton of small bug fixes and enhancements included. From improvements to explosion smoke graphics, to buffing explosion radius, to adding explosive barrels and more, the little bits of polish keep falling into place. Even a few menus have been cleaned up, like the control type selection screen.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2bfec8f1c61934c81cda6b5aad0702a80a28ba6f.jpg
So What's Coming Next?
This was a major patch, so you can expect updates will be a little bit less frequent for a bit as we work on the next major additions.

In the coming weeks, we will be focusing a bit more on the Xbox One port of the game to help get it into a good place for release. We're happy to announce that after the first week of porting, the game is completely playable. We're just working on a core rendering performance improvements to ensure it'll be a great experience for everyone.

In addition, we're also hard at work on the next location - The City. We'll have much more to share in the coming weeks.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1c9c165f339d2e942e029ed6da12614e3af06606.png
Thank you!
Thank you to everyone for playing and supporting the game. Please keep sharing it with your friends and posting feedback in the forums. We're looking forward to playing with everyone!

notes.title: Outbreak: The New Nightmare v1.6.0 Released - Character Progression System!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/60dd3cb598702a5b36713c695845462f0eab5aed.png
Outbreak: The New Nightmare v1.6.0 has been released. This patch introduces the Character Progression System.

What is the Character Progression System
The Character Progression System is a new feature in Outbreak: The New Nightmare that allows you to invest and evolve your character. Characters gain experience by simply playing the game: killing undead, solving puzzles, beating scenarios and surviving Onslaught waves. As they gain experience, they will level up. Leveling up award improvements to base character traits, ability slots and ability points to create a perk loadout.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a7b0985def712cec06f52d3cc862faf17d5aa885.jpg
Character Traits and Abilities
Each character is now separated out more distinctly into a role. Lydia is a gunfighter. Kane is a brawler. Ivy is a tank. And our good friend Harry, well, he's a jack of all trades. Each character has unique traits and abilities that play into their role and make them a valuable member of the team. For example, Lydia will gain improved damage with firearms (and specializes in handguns). Ivy on the other hand will gain health and damage resistance bonuses.

Character abilities also tie into this narrative... but they do have a few that lead off the beaten path. At higher levels, you'll be able to unlock powerful perks like expanding your inventory size, starting with a lockpick, starting with weapons or equipment and more. You're free to spend your points and reallocate your loadout anytime you wish.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/acaba71df17d751789df535180573a77b2cb6217.jpg
Ability Loadouts
As you gain experience and level up, you'll find more abilities are available. You have a fixed number of skill points that are used to build a deck of abilities. You can mix and match, as well as remove and add abilities at any time. Your purchases aren't permanent and you're free to keep trying new combos to see what works best.

Gearing up for Biohazard Difficulty
At higher levels, you'll find you're a bit more prepared for Biohazard difficulty. But even at level 25, it won't be a walk in the park. Your character's evolution is subtle and your perk choices mean a lot. Bringing a Magnum along? Well, now you can't bring a health or damage boost. Your traits and abilities will never make victory assured, and Biohazard is very completable at level 1 if you're really on your game. This system simply gives you a slightly better chance to survive.

What's going to change over Early Access?
We're interested to hear feedback about this system, as well as suggestions on perks and traits. You'll find that abilities and traits will shift over early access, but your progress will remain in-tact. Your XP is stored in Steam, so your characters will be available from any computer.

We have more exciting features and locations in the works. We're excited to keep evolving the game. The best is yet to come! Sound off in the forums or on the official Discord server and let us know what you think! :)

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update 7/4/2017
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f393729c30aecbe46788fc9e1a455fcd4898449.png
Thank you to everyone who has made the first two weeks of Outbreak: The New Nightmare a success! We're off to a great start and it's been wonderful to see all of the feedback, screenshots and videos streaming in from the community!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/34949b8619eda361ee293aee0d1676d1bbe649fa.jpg
Additions Since Launch
Since launch, we've been communicating with the community directly to understand the most requested features, fixes and more! In the last two weeks, we've added the following mostly based on community feedback!

    Significant performance improvements.
    Added the Experiments mode with the Blackout scenario.
    Classic Tank Controls have been added. You can swap between Modern and Tank Controls in the Options Menu.
    Quick 180 degree turn is now available when using Tank controls. Walk in reverse and press the Run button to activate.
    Non-Xbox gamepads now control consistently inside in-game and main menus. PS4 controllers will no longer have issues in the inventory screen.
    Performance fix for corpses dissolving off screen.
    Minor buff to the HP Handgun and the Kraus.
    Enemies now dissolve on death instead of just disappearing.
    Addressed a small issue in the cafeteria where sinks were duplicated.
    Adjusted the Assault Rifle in the Tutorial to make it easier to pick up.
    Addressed additional lighting defects on higher quality settings.
    Minor performance improvements from the lighting changes.
    Further buffed the outbreak scenario Guardian.
    Buffed Onslaught supplies starting on Wave 9.
    Toned down blood effects to improve performance.
    Fixed a lighting issue in a side room before the electrical hallway.
    Removed remaining light fixtures in Blackout.
    In most scenarios, the chest flashlight can be toggled and its state will persist.
    In Blackout, flashlights can no longer be turned off.
    The Guardian at the end of the Outbreak scenario must now be killed to evac.
    The Outbreak scenario Guardian has been buffed.
    Addressed an empty lockpickable room in the Outbreak scenario by adding supplies.
    Added lockpickable rooms to the Blackout scenario filled with supplies.
    Items and some objectives now emit a faint glow instead of the particle burst.
    Fixed an issue where players could regain control of their characters after reaching the Evac Zone.
    Items are no longer randomly culled in the Tutorial scenario.
    Fixed a bug where it was possible to get killed after winning a scenario.
    The Enduring achievement is now awarded on the correct wave.
    Addressed numerous visual issues across the maps.
    Onslaught scores now reset each game.
    Addressed a camera issue in the Central Hub.
    Adjusted particle effects to improve performance and stability.
    Addressed a collision issue that could trap the player.
    The map can now be scrolled and zoomed using your movement bindings and the aim & fire buttons.
    Addressed map label positions.
    Healing icons display correctly on map.
    Addressed some inconsistent text.

And this is just the beginning. We have a long list of planned enhancements, content, fixes and more scheduled for the game over the next year. We may not always keep this break neck cadence of patches, but we'll try to keep them regular and pointed towards community feedback.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/4a5d2aa32a98075c9a0c7f2ef42dbc0ee8b1a18a.jpg
The Next Scenario
We're in the planning stages for the next location, the City Streets. We have the basic concept for the area laid out and now we're going to be putting it together over the next two months or so. We don't have a firm ETA for when it will launch, but the goal will be sometime around the end of summer. When it releases, it will contain a new Campaign mission, a new Onslaught scenario and a fun Experiments scenario on the side (that will not just be Blackout again!). Stay tuned for updates!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2f8201a783ceddc34930d4571908bcb88cde434d.jpg
Upcoming Major Enhancements
The next major enhancement we'll be working on will be the progression and perk systems. We're currently designing out the specifics, but these systems will give you a sense of progression for each individual character. As you gain experience, you'll unlock new skills, perks, attributes and other goodies to assist you in your adventures. These will be key to making survival on harder difficulties like Biohazard possible. BUT DON'T PANIC - These will be subtle buffs and perks will sometimes carry a toll for their benefits. You won't simply become a walking tank.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b44fdc53895eb1be48b16cfce65cc1a7a16a23ee.jpg
We'll have more information on those enhancements in the coming weeks!
Steam Sale
We're in the final hours to grab Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak at great prices. Once the sale ends, they're going back up to full price for a nice lengthy stretch. So grab your friends and ensure everyone has a copy before the sale ends!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/76719cc32c8982238825c8bdac4053a7b3632ed6.jpg
Thank you!
Thank you to everyone for playing, supporting and offering feedback for the game. We're very excited to continue building out the experience with the community and the best is yet to come! Thank you!

notes.content:
Outbreak: The New Nightmare v1.2.0 has been released. This patch includes the following:

    Addressed numerous visual issues across the maps.
    Onslaught scores now reset each game.
    Addressed a camera issue in the Central Hub.
    Added the Experiments mode with the Blackout scenario.
    Adjusted particle effects to improve performance and stability.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/21b77d947b181fa321da99f67ad6f35d9b98caa1.jpg

notes.title: Outbreak: The New Nightmare launches on Early Access June 20th!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f393729c30aecbe46788fc9e1a455fcd4898449.png
We are pleased to announce that Outbreak: The New Nightmare is arriving on Steam Early Access on June 20th, 2017! During the release window, the game will have a discount of 40% off!

It has always been the goal of our Outbreak series to reach a point where it's finally realized in full high definition 3D. We're very happy to finally be bringing this experience to our fans early in the development cycle so they can have immense impact in the direction of the game. Launching in Early Access will allow everyone to play the game and provide their own thoughts on how it can grow!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f96c2cf4119fabb159d0fda9dd479da940387dd.jpg
What's included in the initial Early Access release?
The initial release will include the tutorial, a single Campaign scenario and a single Onslaught mission. Don't fret, this is quite a bit of content to keep you busy!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/ff88c7aea815cbae6452a8df2912d5554f8b86fb.jpg
What will be added as the game produces through Early Access?
We already have several scenarios planned out to add over the coming months. Each of these new scenarios will also bring new Onslaught experiences... and perhaps a few other game modes as well. ;) We'll be looking to include new mechanics in these scenarios as we evolve this title past the basic framework of the original Outbreak game by Dead Drop Studios.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8b3d570d99771da5c5464ee48b0629b0477e5a8d.jpg
What's the plan for pricing?
We're planning to raise the price over time as more content is added to the package. They will be gradual increases until we reach full release, which will launch at what we determine to be a fair price point. But, if you buy early, you'll get the entire game at a great price. Once you've purchased the Early Access version, you'll continue to get all of the new content as its added and already have the full game when it launches!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2fd5d31c0babc8af0fbdffca3fc5c1f7f228b596.jpg
What about multiplayer and single player?
The Early Access release will come with up to 4-player online co-op multiplayer for ALL game modes. All of this content will also be playable in SINGLE PLAYER even OFFLINE!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1734befef0b3772727724019135f431b9c1869a0.jpg
What about trading cards?
As soon as we get sign-off from Valve post launch, we will be adding trading cards. They are already made and ready to go, we just need the green light!

Thank you to everyone who has supported our series so far. We're very excited to be taking this next step. We look forward to surviving with you!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 5/29/2017
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/ce305327fd3b1887aebcd4cc43d23270eae3607c.png
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is now listed on Steam!
We're happy to announce that just about a week ago we cleared Greenlight and Outbreak: The New Nightmare is now listed on Steam! This is an exciting accomplishment and puts us into a great position to release to early access in 2017! But don't worry, you won't be waiting an eternity to play...
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b44fdc53895eb1be48b16cfce65cc1a7a16a23ee.jpg
Our Release Philosophy
Our plans with Outbreak: The New Nightmare is to release early (at a lower price point) and build the game directly with community feedback. The initial Early Access release will feature the first campaign scenario, as well as some bonus content (and be playable in up to 4-player online co-op or in single-player!). We anticipate that the price will rise as content (and feedback) is integrated until we hit the full release. So buying early will ensure you get all of the content long-term at a great price point!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/76719cc32c8982238825c8bdac4053a7b3632ed6.jpg
Latest Development
The focus in the last week has been to continue assembling the first major scenario map, including adding all of the cool props that will give it atmosphere. We're happy to say the map is almost together (but missing the game rules) and it's looking great (and meaty)! You can see screenshots from it within this blog post and the main store page has been updated as well. Once we have more content in, we'll post a brand new multiplayer co-op video showing off some new areas of the scenario in action!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/741ecc5f2a6bb3c087d8bf3fa35f29a110698d62.jpg
Visit our Discord Channel!
We have an official Outbreak Discord channel! It's the best place to get the latest updates (and talk to the developer directly) as the game is built. It's also a great place to find people to play the original 2D Outbreak (by Dead Drop Studios)! Come visit and chat with us!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9fad771b9d19413df10a6ebbb1eb6ad4eb9d1fe2.jpg
What's Next?
Now that the first map is coming together, we're going to begin implementing the game logic for the campaign scenario, as well as the bonus Onslaught mode. Onslaught is going to be a bit of a different beast in Outbreak: The New Nightmare. We're not ready to share information yet, but it's going to be an experience that forces you to keep moving and searching rooms for supplies. Stay tuned for more info!

Thanks for supporting Outbreak: The New Nightmare (and the original Outbreak)! We're looking forward to surviving with you in Early Access in 2017!

Our Release Philosophy
Our plans with Outbreak: The New Nightmare is to release early (at a lower price point) and build the game directly with community feedback. The initial Early Access release will feature the first campaign scenario, as well as some bonus content (and be playable in up to 4-player online co-op or in single-player!). We anticipate that the price will rise as content (and feedback) is integrated until we hit the full release. So buying early will ensure you get all of the content long-term at a great price point!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/76719cc32c8982238825c8bdac4053a7b3632ed6.jpg
Latest Development
The focus in the last week has been to continue assembling the first major scenario map, including adding all of the cool props that will give it atmosphere. We're happy to say the map is almost together (but missing the game rules) and it's looking great (and meaty)! You can see screenshots from it within this blog post and the main store page has been updated as well. Once we have more content in, we'll post a brand new multiplayer co-op video showing off some new areas of the scenario in action!

What's Next?
Now that the first map is coming together, we're going to begin implementing the game logic for the campaign scenario, as well as the bonus Onslaught mode. Onslaught is going to be a bit of a different beast in Outbreak: The New Nightmare. We're not ready to share information yet, but it's going to be an experience that forces you to keep moving and searching rooms for supplies. Stay tuned for more info!
